mapper.sql: l.log_idx, l.user_id, l.user_nm, l.dept_nm, l.position_nm, CAST(l.sv_yn AS VARCHAR) AS sv_yn, l.use_type, CASE l.use_type WHEN 'LOGIN' THEN '로그인' WHEN 'MENU' THEN '메뉴사용' WHEN 'TAG' THEN '출입태그' ELSE l.use_type END AS use_type_nm, l.use_detail, l.menu_cd, l.store_idx, sm.store_nm AS store_nm_join, l.tag_uid, l.distance_m, l.used_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO usage_log ( user_id, user_nm, dept_nm, position_nm, sv_yn, use_type, use_detail ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{deptNm}, #{positionNm}, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{svYn}), ''), 'N'), 'LOGIN', '로그인하였습니다.' )

INSERT INTO usage_log ( user_id, user_nm, dept_nm, position_nm, sv_yn, use_type, use_detail, menu_cd ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{deptNm}, #{positionNm}, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{svYn}), ''), 'N'), 'MENU', #{useDetail}, NULLIF(TRIM(#{menuCd}), '') )

INSERT INTO usage_log ( user_id, user_nm, dept_nm, position_nm, sv_yn, use_type, use_detail, menu_cd, store_idx, tag_uid, tag_lat, tag_lng, distance_m ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{deptNm}, #{positionNm}, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{svYn}), ''), 'Y'), 'TAG', #{useDetail}, NULLIF(TRIM(#{menuCd}), ''), #{storeIdx}, #{tagUid}, #{tagLat}, #{tagLng}, #{distanceM} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM usage_log l LEFT JOIN store_mst sm ON sm.store_idx = l.store_idx
AND l.user_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{userNm}, '%')
AND l.use_type = #{useType}
AND COALESCE(l.sv_yn, 'N') = 'Y'
AND l.used_at >= #{startDt}::date
AND l.used_at < (#{endDt}::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
ORDER BY l.used_at DESC, l.log_idx DESC
LIMIT 2000

SELECT
FROM usage_log l LEFT JOIN store_mst sm ON sm.store_idx = l.store_idx WHERE l.use_type = 'TAG' AND l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.store_idx = #{storeIdx} AND l.used_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM active_mst a WHERE a.usage_log_idx = l.log_idx )
ORDER BY l.used_at DESC, l.log_idx DESC LIMIT 100
